key_insight: PolyGPT generates highly valid polymer structures, but electrolyte conditioning increases repetition and reduces the yield of distinct polymers satisfying combined design requests.
engineering_relevance: Polymer-electrolyte screening should prioritize distinct, novel candidates meeting all design constraints rather than property-prediction error alone.
method: 38.3-million-parameter decoder-only Transformer generates polymer repeat units.
Conditions on optional property targets, chemical-feature inclusion or exclusion, and electrolyte domain.
Evaluates validity, uniqueness, training-catalog novelty, predicted Tg accuracy, and constraint satisfaction.
evidence_signal: At a Tg target of 246.11 K, electrolyte conditioning slightly improved predictor-estimated error from 26.97 to 26.07 K but reduced distinct-valid yield within 50 K from 82.35% to 32.31% of attempts.
watch_item: Tg performance is predictor-estimated; validation-loss checkpoint selection may miss models yielding more distinct, catalog-unseen candidates that meet the target.
paper_title: PolyGPT: A Decoder-Only Transformer for Polymer Electrolyte Design
